results.description:
Fans of Hannah Grace and Elle Kennedy, meet your new obsession! The international college-romance phenomenon with over one million copies sold and now an Amazon Prime TV series.

He’s the college bad boy trying to change gears . . .

When Donovan, basketball star and notorious heartthrob of the Campus Drivers, realises just how much damage his womanising behaviour has caused, he decides it's time to change his ways and become the perfect boyfriend. And who better to coach him than romance-obsessed, all-round good girl, Carrie?

. . . but she’s never believed in the Reformed Player trope.

Too bad Carrie wants nothing to do with him. She’d much rather lose herself in the heroes from her romance novels. They’re uncomplicated and drama-free, just the way she likes it.

If only Donovan would take the hint. Now she’s reluctantly putting him through his paces in a tough, no-nonsense crash course in love, where the lessons are starting to feel all too real. But can this hopeless romantic really believe a heartbreaker is capable of happily ever after?

Pick this up if you love: reformed playboy, he falls first / she falls harder, opposites attract, tutor / student relationship, sports romance.
